We need to inspect network. Input weights matrix 4x2: rows correspond to hidden units. So hidden unit0: weights [1,0]; unit1: [-1,0]; unit2: [0,1]; unit3: [0,-1]. biases all zero. ReLU.

Output weights 2x4: first row for class0: [-1,1,0,0]; second row for class1: [1,-1,0,0]. biases zero.

So outputs: z0 = -h0 + h1; z1 = h0 - h1. So z0 = -(h0 - h1); z1 = h0 - h1. So z1 = -z0. Thus argmax: if h0>h1 then z1>z0 => class1. If h0<h1 then class0. If equal, tie -> class0.

Thus classification depends on difference h0-h1. h0 = ReLU(x0). h1 = ReLU(-x0). So h0-h1 = ReLU(x0)-ReLU(-x0). This equals x0 if x0>0, -x0 if x0<0, 0 if x0=0. So sign matches desired: class1 iff x0>0. Good. Nuisance x1 not used. So already correct. So return NONE.
